## Key findings {#summary-of-the-task-2-detection-score-results}

```{r task2-summary-text}
#| include: false
#| cache: false
# Every number below comes from objects computed above. A difference is called
# higher or lower only when its interval excludes zero (as on the Task 1 page);
# otherwise the text says that the interval includes no difference.
task2_summary_p <- function(p) ifelse(p < .001, "< .001", paste("=", p_text(p)))

task2_summary_effects <- function(estimate, lower, upper, describe, outcome) {
  lower_set <- which(upper < 0)
  higher_set <- which(lower > 0)
  unclear_set <- setdiff(seq_along(estimate), c(lower_set, higher_set))
  sentences <- character()
  if (length(lower_set) > 0) {
    sentences <- c(sentences, paste0(
      "Relative to Basic topoplot, ", outcome, " clearly lower for ",
      knitr::combine_words(describe(lower_set)), "."
    ))
  }
  if (length(higher_set) > 0) {
    sentences <- c(sentences, paste0(
      "Relative to Basic topoplot, ", outcome, " clearly higher for ",
      knitr::combine_words(describe(higher_set)), "."
    ))
  }
  if (length(unclear_set) == length(estimate)) {
    sentences <- c(sentences, paste0(
      "No visualization type differed clearly from Basic topoplot: all ",
      number_word(length(estimate)), " intervals included 0."
    ))
  } else if (length(unclear_set) > 0) {
    sentences <- c(sentences, paste0(
      "The intervals for the other ", number_word(length(unclear_set)),
      " visualization type", if (length(unclear_set) > 1) "s" else "",
      " included 0."
    ))
  }
  if (length(unclear_set) > 0) {
    largest <- unclear_set[which.max(abs(estimate[unclear_set]))]
    sentences <- c(sentences, paste0(
      "The largest of these was for ", describe(largest),
      ", but its interval also included 0."
    ))
  }
  paste(sentences, collapse = " ")
}

# Overall likelihood-ratio test of visualization type (the table above).
task2_vistype_lrt <- anova(model_task2_no_vistype, model_task2)
task2_lrt_chi <- task2_vistype_lrt[["Chisq"]][2]
task2_lrt_df <- task2_vistype_lrt[["Chi Df"]][2]
task2_lrt_p <- task2_vistype_lrt[["Pr(>Chisq)"]][2]

# Expected scores E[y], averaged over random effects.
task2_summary_highest <- task2_estimates |> slice_max(predicted_score, n = 1)
task2_summary_lowest <- task2_estimates |> slice_min(predicted_score, n = 1)

# Primary contrasts on the expected-score scale.
task2_summary_primary <- task2_basic_contrasts |> arrange(vistype)
task2_primary_sentence <- task2_summary_effects(
  estimate = task2_summary_primary$difference,
  lower = task2_summary_primary$lower_ci,
  upper = task2_summary_primary$upper_ci,
  describe = \(i) sprintf(
    "%s (%+.1f pp, simultaneous 95%% CI %+.1f to %+.1f pp, adjusted *p* %s)",
    table_vistype(as.character(task2_summary_primary$vistype[i])),
    100 * task2_summary_primary$difference[i],
    100 * task2_summary_primary$lower_ci[i],
    100 * task2_summary_primary$upper_ci[i],
    task2_summary_p(task2_summary_primary$p.value[i])
  ),
  outcome = "the expected detection score was"
)
task2_any_primary_effect <- any(
  task2_summary_primary$upper_ci < 0 | task2_summary_primary$lower_ci > 0
)

# Two-part model: contrasts with Basic in each part (logit scale).
task2_part_sentence <- function(model_name, outcome) {
  rows <- task2_peak_contrasts |> filter(model == model_name) |> arrange(vistype)
  task2_summary_effects(
    estimate = rows$estimate,
    lower = rows$lower,
    upper = rows$upper,
    describe = \(i) sprintf(
      "%s (%+.2f logit, Dunnett-adjusted 95%% CI %+.2f to %+.2f)",
      table_vistype(as.character(rows$vistype[i])),
      rows$estimate[i], rows$lower[i], rows$upper[i]
    ),
    outcome = outcome
  )
}
task2_part_effects <- task2_peak_contrasts |>
  filter(model != "Ordered beta (primary)", excludes_zero)
task2_part_overall_p <- setNames(task2_peak_overall$p, task2_peak_overall$part)

# Posterior predictive check of exact-peak responses.
task2_ppc_level <- task2_peak_ppc |> filter(statistic == "share_one")
task2_ppc_diff <- task2_peak_ppc |>
  filter(statistic == "share_one_vs_basic", vistype != "basic")
task2_ppc_outside <- bind_rows(task2_ppc_level, task2_ppc_diff) |> filter(!inside)
task2_ppc_count <- function(inside) {
  if (all(inside)) {
    paste("all", number_word(length(inside)))
  } else {
    paste(number_word(sum(inside)), "of", number_word(length(inside)))
  }
}
task2_ppc_sentence <- paste0(
  "The observed share of exact-peak responses lay inside the 95% interval of ",
  scales::comma(task2_peak_n_sim), " data sets simulated from the primary model for ",
  task2_ppc_count(task2_ppc_level$inside),
  " visualization types, and the observed difference from Basic topoplot for ",
  task2_ppc_count(task2_ppc_diff$inside), ".",
  if (nrow(task2_ppc_outside) > 0) {
    paste0(
      " Outside the interval: ",
      knitr::combine_words(sprintf(
        "%s %s (observed %+.1f pp, simulated 95%% interval %+.1f to %+.1f pp)",
        table_vistype(as.character(task2_ppc_outside$vistype)),
        if_else(
          task2_ppc_outside$statistic == "share_one",
          "share", "difference from Basic"
        ),
        100 * task2_ppc_outside$observed,
        100 * task2_ppc_outside$lower,
        100 * task2_ppc_outside$upper
      )),
      ". The single ordered-beta predictor does not fully reproduce this exact-peak ",
      "difference, which is why the two-part model is reported."
    )
  } else {
    " The primary model reproduces the exact-peak responses."
  }
)

# Rank and top-3 sensitivity outcomes.
task2_scale_free_significant <- task2_outcome_significant |>
  filter(outcome %in% c("Rank score", "Top 3"))
task2_lowest_by_outcome <- task2_outcome_contrasts |>
  group_by(outcome) |>
  slice_min(estimate, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pull(vistype) |>
  as.character()
task2_lowest_consistent <- length(unique(task2_lowest_by_outcome)) == 1
# Does the exact-peak part of the two-part model point the other way for the
# visualization with the lowest score estimate?
task2_lowest_peak <- task2_peak_contrasts |>
  filter(
    model == "Exact peak (logistic)",
    vistype == task2_lowest_by_outcome[1]
  )
task2_lowest_peak_estimate <- task2_lowest_peak$estimate

task2_interpretation <- if (task2_any_primary_effect) {
  paste0(
    "At least one primary contrast excludes zero after adjustment; see the ",
    "sentences above for which visualization types and in which direction."
  )
} else {
  paste0(
    "Taken together, the data give no clear evidence that any uncertainty ",
    "visualization changed detection scores compared with Basic topoplot: the ",
    "overall test gave *p* ", task2_summary_p(task2_lrt_p),
    ", and no Dunnett-adjusted contrast with Basic excluded zero. ",
    if (task2_lowest_consistent) {
      paste0(
        table_vistype(task2_lowest_by_outcome[1]), " had the lowest estimate for ",
        "the score, the rank score and top 3, so it is a candidate for a small ",
        "detection cost, but this study cannot distinguish that cost from no ",
        "difference. ",
        if (task2_lowest_peak_estimate > 0) {
          paste0(
            "Its exact-peak estimate in the two-part model pointed the other way ",
            "(more exact hits than Basic",
            if (task2_lowest_peak$excludes_zero) "" else ", interval including 0",
            "), so a possible cost ",
            "would lie in how close the misses were, not in how often the peak was ",
            "found. "
          )
        } else {
          ""
        }
      )
    } else {
      ""
    },
    if (nrow(task2_part_effects) > 0 && all(task2_part_overall_p >= 0.05)) {
      paste0(
        "The two-part interval", if (nrow(task2_part_effects) > 1) "s" else "",
        " that excluded zero come", if (nrow(task2_part_effects) > 1) "" else "s",
        " from a model whose overall tests were not significant and should be ",
        "read as exploratory. "
      )
    } else {
      ""
    },
    "The results should be reported as estimates with intervals."
  )
}
```

- **Overall test.** Adding visualization type
  `r if (task2_lrt_p < 0.05) "improved" else "did not clearly improve"` the primary
  ordered-beta model, $\chi^2(`r task2_lrt_df`) = `r sprintf("%.2f", task2_lrt_chi)`$,
  *p* `r task2_summary_p(task2_lrt_p)`.
- **Expected detection scores** (E[y], averaged over participants, stimuli and images).
  They ranged from `r scales::percent(task2_summary_lowest$predicted_score, accuracy = 0.1)`
  for `r table_vistype(as.character(task2_summary_lowest$vistype))` to
  `r scales::percent(task2_summary_highest$predicted_score, accuracy = 0.1)` for
  `r table_vistype(as.character(task2_summary_highest$vistype))`; Basic topoplot had
  `r scales::percent(task2_expected_value("basic", "marginal"), accuracy = 0.1)`.
- **Primary contrasts** (expected-score difference, Dunnett-adjusted for six comparisons
  with Basic). `r task2_primary_sentence`
- **Two-part model, overall tests.** Visualization type did
  `r if (task2_part_overall_p[["Exact peak"]] < 0.05) "" else "not clearly "`improve
  the exact-peak part (`r task2_peak_overall_text("Exact peak")`) and did
  `r if (task2_part_overall_p[["Misses"]] < 0.05) "" else "not clearly "`improve the
  part for the closeness of misses (`r task2_peak_overall_text("Misses")`).
- **Two-part model, exact peak** (logistic, Dunnett-adjusted).
  `r task2_part_sentence("Exact peak (logistic)", "the log-odds of selecting the strongest region were")`
- **Two-part model, closeness of misses** (beta, Dunnett-adjusted).
  `r task2_part_sentence("Misses (beta)", "the mean score of missed trials was")`
- **Posterior predictive check.** `r task2_ppc_sentence`
- **Rank and top-3 outcomes** (Dunnett-adjusted).
  `r if (nrow(task2_scale_free_significant) == 0) "For neither scale-free outcome did any visualization differ from Basic topoplot." else paste0("For the rank score, ", task2_outcome_sentence("Rank score"), "; for top 3, ", task2_outcome_sentence("Top 3"), ".")`
- **Scoring caveat.** For `r task2_p3_low_modal_top_region_n` of
  `r n_distinct(task2_model$stimulus[task2_model$pattern == "P3"])` P3 stimuli, the most
  frequently selected region (`r task2_p3_low_modal_top_region`) ranked only
  `r scales::ordinal(min(task2_p3_low_modal_top_ranks))`–`r scales::ordinal(max(task2_p3_low_modal_top_ranks))`
  by score. Participants may have targeted the voltage peak rather than the SNR peak;
  this is not resolved here.
- **Interpretation.** `r task2_interpretation`
